cases.title: Initial Hidden State of Text Box
cases.description: Verify that the text box (data-testid='text-box') is initially hidden by default when the application loads.

cases.title: Toggle Visibility via Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Toggle Text Box" button (data-testid="toggle-button") toggles the visibility of the text box by adding or removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that the system handles rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button reliably, ensuring the final state correctly reflects the last user action without inconsistency.

cases.title: Verify initial hidden state of the text box
cases.description: Verify that the text box (data-testid='text-box') is initially hidden upon page load and lacks the 'show' class.

cases.title: Verify text box becomes visible when clicking Toggle Text Box button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') makes the text box (data-testid='text-box') visible by adding the 'show' class.

cases.title: Verify text box is hidden when clicking Close button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate voice dropdown and assign voice on selection
cases.description: Verify that after the user opens the text box using the toggle button, the system populates the voice select dropdown with available voices via speechSynthesis.getVoices(), updates when 'voiceschanged' fires, and assigns the selected voice to message.voice.

cases.title: Select voice from dropdown and set for speech synthesis
cases.description: Verify that users can select a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') and that upon selection, the system sets the chosen voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Dropdown populated with available voices on page load
cases.description: Verify that the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') is automatically populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded.

cases.title: Handle multiple voice selections
cases.description: Verify that the system handles multiple sequential voice selections from the dropdown, ensuring that the last selected voice is correctly set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Support specific language codes in voice options
cases.description: Verify that the application supports voice options including specific language codes such as 'CN' for Chinese or 'US' for English, and accurately sets the voice containing these codes as the active voice when selected.

cases.title: Read text aloud using selected voice and text area input
cases.description: Verify that when the user enters text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'), toggles the text box (data-testid='text-box') via the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system reads the entered text aloud using the selected voice from the dropdown (data-testid='voice-select').

cases.title: Dynamic Generation of Predefined Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system dynamically generates predefined phrase boxes in the main section based on a data array, where each box contains an image and a paragraph representing a phrase.

cases.title: Read Phrase Aloud and Highlight on Click
cases.description: Verify that when a user clicks on a phrase box, the system reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Handle Normal Clicks and Sequential Clicks Across Different Boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly handles normal clicks and sequential clicks across different boxes, ensuring speech playback and visual feedback are triggered accurately.

cases.title: Handle Rapid Repeated Clicks on the Same Phrase Box
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly handles rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box, ensuring speech playback and visual feedback function accurately without inconsistency.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are fully covered by distinct and testable cases. No blockers, redundant excess, or missing explicit scenarios found.
All requirements are fully and accurately covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing explicit scenarios found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors: initial hidden state of the text box, toggling visibility via the toggle button using the 'show' class, handling rapid repeated clicks, and handling boundary conditions. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2 describes multiple distinct behaviors: initial hidden state, making the text box visible via the toggle button, hiding the text box via the close button, and managing the 'show' class. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors: populating the voice dropdown using speechSynthesis.getVoices() upon opening the text box, listening for the 'voiceschanged' event to update the dropdown, and assigning the selected voice to message.voice. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4 describes multiple distinct behaviors: selecting a voice from the dropdown to set speech synthesis, populating the dropdown on page load, handling multiple voice selections to keep the last selected voice active, and supporting specific language codes. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors: entering text into the textarea, toggling the text box, and reading the entered text aloud using the selected voice upon clicking the 'Read Text' button. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6 describes multiple distinct behaviors: dynamically generating predefined phrase boxes with images and paragraphs from a data array, reading associated text aloud when a box is clicked, visually highlighting the clicked box with the active class for 800 milliseconds, and handling normal, sequential, and rapid repeated clicks.
